items.title: Shortage of Turbines Drives Market for Second-Hand Market for AI Data Centers
items.summary: New gas turbines now take years to arrive, so AI data center developers are hunting for used machines and buying entire power plants. Five stocks sit on opposite sides of that scramble, and one of them is selling at a premium.

items.title: LS Power Buying Nearly 5 GW of Gas-Fired Generation From NRG in $4-Billion Deal
items.summary: New York-headquartered LS Power said it has agreed to pay $4 billion to buy six natural gas-fired power generation facilities from NRG Energy. The deal announced Monday is for generation assets located in Texas, New York, Rhode Island, and Connecticut. The power stations together represent almost 5 GW of generation capacity.
